content: Tiweṣṣa zi jjihet n wagřa n umqarreb
“Mařa ittwaf uceffar ɛad am ittacar, uca iwta i-t uca immut, war ttiřin idammen x wenni t yufin.
Mařa tenqar-dd xas tfuct, ad xas iřin idammen di ssibbet-a. Ad as ixeǧeṣ uceffar marra. Mařa war ɣares ca, ad immenz di ssibbet n tucceffra nnes.
Mařa tᵉttwaf tucceffart teddar deg ufus nnes, ma d afunas i tt tuɣa niɣ d aɣyuř niɣ d ijjen zeg wuǧi, ittxeṣṣa as ad ixeǧeṣ tnayen n tseqqar.

Mařa ijja ḥed ad heddan řmař iyyar niɣ amarjeɛ n uḍiř uca yarwes dayes taḥimart nnes uca ad asen iḍřeq ařami ad heddan di temmurt n wenneɣni, xenni ad tt ixeǧeṣ zi řemxeyyer n yeyyar nnes u zi řemxeyyer n umarjeɛ n uḍiř nnes.
Mařa teffeɣ-dd tmessi uca teřqef asennan uca tecca tiqebbiḍin n imendi niɣ imendi ibedden niɣ iyyar, xenni wenni iqqden timessi ad ixeǧeṣ marra min ittwacemḍen.
Mařa iḥḍa ḥed i wajjar nnes nnuqart niɣ řeqcuɛ u man aya ittwacar as zi taddart n weryaz nni, xenni aceffar, mařa ufin t, ad ixeǧeṣ tnayen n tseqqar.
Mařa war ittwif uceffar, řexdenni ad ssqarrben bab n taddart ɣar AREBBI maḥend ad ssnen ma war isswiẓẓeḍ ufus nnes ɣar wagřa n wajjar nnes.

Kuř aɛeddi zi jjihet n ufunas niɣ n weɣyuř niɣ n ijj zeg wuǧi niɣ n warruḍ niɣ n min iweddaren i zzayes inna ḥed: ‘Aqa-t d wa!’, ad dd-tas tmesřact i iǧan jar asen s tnayen zzat i řquḍat uca wenni ad xas ḥekmen řquḍat ad ixeǧeṣ i wajjar nnes tnayen n tseqqar.
Mařa iwca ḥed i wajjar nnes aɣyuř niɣ afunas niɣ ijj n zeg wuǧi, niɣ mammec ma tegga řebhimet, ḥima ad t iḥḍa uca immut niɣ yarreẓ niɣ ucaren t, am war iẓri ḥed,
xenni ad tiři tjaǧit ɣar SIDI jar asen s tnayen belli war isswiẓẓeḍ afus nnes ɣar wagřa n wajjar nnes. Bab nnes ad iqbeř tajaǧit nnes uca ad taf břa ma ad t ittxeǧeṣ wenneɣni.
Maca mařa ittwacar nican zzayes, di lḥala-ya ad ixeǧeṣ i bab nnes.
Mařa iban aqa ittwamezzeq nican, ad t yawi d burhan uca war ittxeǧiṣ min ittwamezzqen.
Mařa yarḍeř ḥed ca x wajjar nnes uca tarreẓ niɣ temmut di řɣayeb n bab nnes, ittxeṣṣa as ad tt ixeǧeṣ marra.
Maca mařa bab nnes tuɣa iḥḍar, war tt ittxiǧaṣ. Mařa tuɣa icra tt xas, ad dd-yas x řexřaṣ nnes.”
X usefsad n arruḥ d arrimet, x yinni iḍeɛfen u x uceqqef di Arebbi
“Uca mařa immarḍen ḥed x ca n teɛzařect, tuɣa war tt ixḍib ḥed ɛad, uca iṭṭeṣ akides, ittxeṣṣa as ad as iwc ṣṣadaq imun maḥend ad tt yawi d tamɣart.
Mařa babas war ixs ad as tt iwc, ad as iwzen ɛad ṣṣadaq n teɛzuray s nnuqart.
War ttejji taseḥḥart ad teddar.
Man wen i ɣa iṭṭṣen ak-d ijj n řmař, ad t nɣen nican.
Wenni i ɣa iwehhben ca n tɣarṣt i irebbiten, war iǧi mɣir i SIDI waha, ittxeṣṣa ad ittwaḥarrem i uteḥḥi.
War ddeǧem abarrani u war xas ttzeyyarem, minzi tuɣa uřa d kenniw d ibarraniyyen di temmurt n Miṣra.
War ttdeǧi ca ict n tajjač niɣ ijj n uyujiř.
Mařa tiwḍed ad t tesseḥqared aṭṭas uca netta isɣuy-dd ɣari, aqa Necc s uɣiř ad sřeɣ i tɣuyyit nnes.
Ad yareɣ weɣḍab inu uca Necc ad kenniw nɣeɣ s ssif, timeṭṭa nwem ad dewřent d tijjař d tarrawt nwem d iyujiřen.
Mařa tareḍřed nnuqart i řgens inu, i umezřuḍ i din ɣarek, xenni war kides ttegged am ittegg bab n umarwas: war xas ttegg ca arriba.
Mařa teksid arruḍ n wajjar nnec d aḍman, arr as t qbeř ma ad teɣři tfuct.
Minzi war ɣares mɣir ařeḥḥaf wanita, aqa-t d arruḍ x teřmect nnes. Min di ɣa iṭṭeṣ xenni? Xmi ɣari dd ɣa isɣuy, řexdenni ad as sřeɣ, minzi Necc aqa d aḥnin!
War ttceqqif di AREBBI u war ttekkʷar řḥakem n řgens nnec.
War sɛeṭṭařa taccuret n tmeyra nnec niɣ aḥřay n teysart nnec. Ad ayi tewced uřa d amenzu n iḥenjiren nnec.
Ammu i ɣa tegged ɛawed s ifunasen nnec d wuǧi nnec. Sebɛa n wussan ad iřin ak-d yemmatsen uca ɣar wass wiss tmenya ad ayi ten tewced.
Ad ayi tiřim d imqeddasen u war ttᵉttem aysum i ittwamezzqen di řexřa. Ad t tenḍarem i yiṭan.”

footnotes.text: imqeddasen- s Tɛibranit ‘iwdan imqeddasen’ niɣ ‘iryazen imqeddasen’.
